Mike owns the file Mikefile and Bob and Kate can read and write the file Mikefile. Assume the owner of a file can execute it. 1. Create an access control matrix describing this system. 2. Suppose the owner of a file can add and remove permissions to that file. Mike removes Kate's permission and give permission to Alice to read and write Mikefile. Show the new access control matrix. 3.
